When an adjective ends in the letter y preceded by a consonant (such as dry or happy), standard English orthographic rules dictate that the final y must be changed to the letter i before appending the comparative suffix -er. II. If the annual rent paid exceeds ₹1,00,000, the employee must report the PAN of the landlord to the employer to claim the exemption.
